name: Nekusar, the Mindrazer
description: Speaker who extracts the cost of opposition from wits.

description_citations.text: Foundations Commander: card flavor text (Foundations Commander, 2026), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nekusar is killed in his own throne room after a plot to assassinate a rival backfires, but returns as a lich lord.
timeline.quote: When one of his plots to assassinate a rival backfired, Nekusar was killed in his own throne room.

citation.text: "The Ten Commanders". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Nekusar's brutal death and unnatural rebirth as lich king.
timeline.quote: His enemies wondered if the lich king's brutal death and unnatural rebirth had been his plan all along.

citation.text: Nekusar, the Mindrazer (Commander 2013, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A former king who became a lich lord after being killed in his own throne room and now monitors the court through informants.
